QuestInfo.name: [8th Anniversary] Maple Tree Seedling
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has something nice for MapleStory's 8th birthday...\n\n#e#b(Can be done until 06/16/13)#k#n
QuestInfo.1: The Maple Administrator asked you to raise a Maple Tree Seedling. Feed it items to make it grow until it gives you some sweet Maple Fruit!\n\n#e#b(Can be done until 06/16/13)#k#n
QuestInfo.2: You became a Maple Tree overseer.

0.0: I checked all seven of my calendars, and they all say the same thing, #h0#. It's MapleStory's 8th anniversary!
0.1: To celebrate, I'm handing out #bMaple Tree Seedlings#k for Maplers to raise. Simply double-click on it to send it to your Item Pot.

yes.0: Maple Tree Seedlings grow as you feed it items. When it's full-grown, you can get a piece of fruit!

no.0: Maybe you should double-check your own calendars and planners. It's a time to celebrate!

1.0: Well done! I have an entire row of Maple Tree Seedlings myself, and I check on them 43 times an hour.

yes.0: You can get more Maple Tree Seedlings by eliminating monsters. I hope you're enjoying MapleStory's 8th anniversary!

default.0: Maple Tree Seedlings grow as you feed it items. When it's full-grown, you can get a piece of fruit!
